## About
DSD Automotive is a restoration and customization shop on N Kealy Ave in Lewisville, owned by Dave and Stephen DuSold. The work covers design and planning, restoration, custom paint, fabrication, paint and metal polishing, and paintless dent repair.
The shop describes itself as your automotive concierge. One reviewer wrote that Dave walked him through what would give him the best bang for the buck on a limited budget, and another said communication throughout the whole process was extremely easy.
DSD Automotive holds a 4.6 rating from 26 Google reviews.

## Services
- Design & Planning: Consultation and design for your next build, whether it is headed for the show field or simply for you.
- Restoration: Restoration of classics, including frame-off work, and Pro-Touring builds.
- Customization: Changes made to suit you, from suspension upgrades to restoring an interior in exotic leathers.
- Custom Paint: Custom paint work as part of a restoration or a personal build.
- Fabrication: One-off pieces made for your car, such as a harness bar.
- Paint & Metal Polishing: Polishing of paint and metal to bring out the finish.
- Paintless Dent Repair: Dent removal without repainting the panel.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The shop is closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on motorcycles?
A: Yes. The shop cares for both cars and motorcycles.

Q: Do you handle maintenance, or only builds?
A: Both. The work ranges from maintenance and repairs to ground-up builds.

Q: How soon will I hear back after using the contact form?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours.
